title: Engine adapter: sync_members()
description: Reconcile the site's shadow engine users with the tenant's memberships and role assignments (ADR-0007 items 4, 9, 11, 13). Shadow users have no password, no API key, no email delivery and cannot sign in. There is no field for any of these.

mode.description: full: members is the complete desired set; shadow users not listed are disabled. delta: only the listed members change.

syncVersion.description: Monotonic per tenant, issued by the assignment store. Lower than or equal to the last applied version: stale_sync_version (a replay with the same idempotency key returns the stored result instead).

memberRef.description: Opaque, stable, per-tenant membership reference. Not an email, phone or global person id.

roleIds.description: Blueprint role ids; each must be an active role in the site's applied configuration (else unknown_role, nothing changed).

displayName.description: Shown in the tenant's own records (for example 'created by'). Personal data.

syncVersion.description: Last applied version after this call.
